_meta.note: Grifon self-promo slate (split-screen format): 2 Comparison old-vs-new + 2 UGC Grifon-vs-slop. Use with --master tools/batch-creative-codex.split.master.txt. SCENE carries the LEFT (losing) vs RIGHT (Grifon) description.

angles.headline: Old Way vs New Way
angles.scene: LEFT half (old way): an exhausted Filipino small-business owner at midnight, buried under laptops, paperwork and stacks of expensive agency invoices, cold dim grey light, stressed and overwhelmed. RIGHT half (new way): the confident person from the reference, relaxed and smiling, holding a phone showing finished polished ads, warm Grifon-gold glow, calm and in control.

angles.headline: Stop The Hard Way
angles.scene: LEFT half (hard way): a chaotic do-it-yourself marketing mess — cluttered desk, messy half-finished designs, tangled cables, a frustrated overwhelmed person, washed-out grey tones. RIGHT half (easy way): the confident person from the reference, composed, one clean premium Grifon ad glowing on a phone, gold glow, effortless.

angles.headline: Grifon vs AI Slop
angles.principle: Quality authority — kills the 'AI makes garbage' objection
angles.scene: LEFT half (AI slop): an ugly generic AI-generated ad mockup — distorted warped features, muddy washed-out colors, cheap amateur layout, clearly low quality. RIGHT half (Grifon): a crisp premium ad featuring the confident person from the reference, clean bold headline, gold accents, sharp and professional.

angles.headline: Your Ads Deserve Better
angles.scene: LEFT half: a low-quality messy generic AI ad, blurry, off-brand, forgettable, dull grey. RIGHT half: a polished premium Grifon ad featuring the confident person from the reference, gold glow, bold clean design, scroll-stopping.
